$comment: Source of truth for Runic Views Window host support per runtime identifier. tools/dotnet-runic/metadata/generate.mjs embeds it in the CLI compatibility set and renders the README support table; eng/support.test.mjs keeps ci-verified entries in line with the Native job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. RIDs that are not listed are unsupported.

statuses.ci-verified: Runic CI builds and runs the host's native window layer on this RID for changes that affect it.
statuses.packaged-unverified: The packages ship native assets for it, but Runic CI does not run it. Test the published application on a real target machine.
statuses.unsupported: Runic does not support the host on this RID: it ships no native assets for it, or the platform is not a Runic target.

requirements.note: Evergreen runtime; Windows 11 includes it. CS-WebUI uses it only when no Chromium-family browser is installed.
The documented minimum stays macOS 15, the oldest macOS in the .NET 10 supported-OS policy; CI tests only the latest macOS on Apple silicon. WKWebView is part of macOS.

requirements.component: Alpine Linux (musl), an Alpine release that .NET 10 supports
requirements.note: For the linux-musl RIDs, with Alpine's gtk+3.0 and webkit2gtk-4.1 packages. CI runs Alpine 3.22 with WebKit's sandbox enabled; Runic.Desktop.Gtk4 is not CI-verified on musl.
